scope: Complete registered cubic machine proof device schedule before private seed import, with existing prepared public data. Report includes known host payloads and borrowed source capacities.
checks: early rejection for managed bytes, per-allocation bytes, allocation count, host bytes and RNG slots
no allocation/transfer/work on rejected registered requests
source spare-capacity accounting shared with OpenCL
same-runtime cross-thread allocation and RNG-slot rejection
planned peaks cover small single/mixed-height proofs and exactly match the full-size proof
independent CPU preprocessing reconstruction, registered verification and tampering rejection
limitations: Source construction before the API call and process RSS remain caller/controller responsibilities.
Production wrapper/merge requests, public dispatch and worker/pool integration remain unfinished.
Focused sanitizer checks do not qualify full-size recursive instrumentation.
Resource admission is not a transaction-throughput or speedup benchmark.
